operation.text: Dashboard sends POST /places/{id}/refresh to the declared Places.Refresh target.

request.text: Dashboard URL-encodes request.params.id into the path and sends POST without a request body. The wrapper shows no idempotency key.
Places receives the path id and cancellation token; it looks up the place before enqueue.

response.text: If no place is found, Places returns 404 with PLACE_NOT_FOUND and does not reach the enqueue call.
If the place is found, Places awaits repository.Enqueue and returns 202 with placeId and status QUEUED; that status does not establish forecast completion.
Dashboard forwards the upstream status and parsed JSON response.
